page.description: Elysium runs a browser for each account you sign in to here, and keeps it signed in. You sign in once, on the real page, and Elysium uses the account as you do.
page.empty: No browsers yet. Add one to sign in to Outlook, Gmail, or any other site.
page.loadError: Your browsers could not be loaded.

form.title: Add a browser
form.description: It opens the page below, where you sign in yourself.
form.name: Name

errors.startUrlInvalid: Enter an https:// address with a host name.
errors.portsExhausted: Every browser this host can stream is in use. Remove one first.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.body: Its browser and everything it is signed in to on this host are removed. The account itself is untouched; sign in again by adding a new browser.

reset.title: Reset {{name}}?
reset.body: This empties the browser's profile, which signs it out of every account it is signed in to on this host. It then starts again at its sign-in page, ready for you to sign in. The accounts themselves are untouched.

toasts.startedOver: {{name}} is back at its sign-in page.
toasts.reset: {{name}} is starting again with an empty profile.

session.hint: Click the picture to use it. Typing and pasting go to the page, so a password manager on this computer works there too.
session.starting: Starting the browser. The first one can take a minute.
session.missing: This browser does not exist, or it is not yours.
session.startOverHint: Back to the sign-in page, closing every other tab. You stay signed in to whatever you already signed in to.
session.resetHint: Sign this browser out of everything and start again from an empty profile.

connectors.title: {{service}} mail
connectors.offer: Elysium can read this mailbox: new mail lands in your inbox as it arrives. What is already there is recorded without filling your inbox.
connectors.reading: Elysium reads this mailbox every minute without opening anything, so your mail stays unread.

stream.label: The browser's screen
stream.unreachable: The browser is running, but its picture could not reach you. The host must accept its media ports, 59000 to 59007, over both UDP and TCP, from your network.
